plain_text:
Jeff Chandler appears in 90 recordings across 15 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1946 to 1957. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Jeff Chandler most often in Michael Shayne, Frontier Town, Lux Radio Theatre, Screen Directors Playhouse, The Damon Runyon Theatre, The Whistler, Escape, and Academy Award Theater.

Characters credited here include Michael Shayne and Chad Remington.
